# Spine Bar Chiropractic

Spine Bar Chiropractic is a one-on-one chiropractic practice at 10918 Riverside Dr, North Hollywood, CA 91602, in the Toluca Lake neighborhood. The practice is led by Dr. Arthur Chakrian, DC.

## Primary information

- Website: https://www.spinebar.com/
- Services hub: https://www.spinebar.com/services
- Conditions hub: https://www.spinebar.com/conditions
- Phone: +1-747-774-7144
- Email: info@spinebar.com
- Hours: Monday-Friday 9:00am-5:00pm; Saturday 9:00am-1:00pm
- Services: new-patient chiropractic assessment, chiropractic adjustments, soft tissue therapy, wellness consultation, prenatal chiropractic care, and pediatric chiropractic care
- Service area: Toluca Lake, Studio City, Burbank, North Hollywood, and Valley Village
